key_findings: Peripheral sympathectomy with 6-OHDA reduced spinal P2Y12, Iba-1, p-p38 and cytokines and attenuated allodynia in rat SNL.
Intrathecal ticagrelor was similarly effective and combination gave no added benefit, supporting a coupled sympathetic-microglial P2Y12 axis.
